title: His banjos: Vega and Paramount
summary: He used a Vega, then bought a Paramount tenor banjo for $375 on the Marable boat; he never played five-string.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: What kind of banjo have you got?

Well, I have a Viga banjo. I was using the Viga banjo then, but when I got on the boat with Fate, well, I was making pretty good money and I bought me a Paramount, and I remember that was a $375 banjo in those days.
Yeah, in those days. It was a pretty good banjo.
It was. The Bay Ridley band, well, they always were a high priced banjo.
Oh, yeah, it was a tenor banjo, strictly, yeah.
It was a tenor you use today.
Yeah, that's all I played was tenor banjo.
You never did play G, G banjo, banjo, you know, what are they called?

You got a five string banjo? Yeah. No, that's a little different. I know where they play that. But as far as the Ghetto banjo, I knew I could play that, because I just liked the other, the other guitar.
